translate_en|mods/ConnectGeneratorsB42/4: Base hourly fuel draw of one running Desktop Computer, before the Generator Fuel Consumption multiplier. Set to 0 to make computers free to run. Vanilla references: fridge 0.08, fridge+freezer 0.13.
Disables the 'Computer - Generators' context menu, all terminal tabs, pager inventory options (Read Alerts, Volume, Date Format), and the Set/Rename Generator Network ID option.
Hides the Network Map tab inside the computer terminal. Automatically disabled when Disable Computer System is on.
Disables the Pager Configuration tab and all pager inventory options (Read Alerts, Volume, Date Format, Turn On/Off). Automatically disabled when Disable Computer System is on.
Horizontal distance used to link generators into the same shared power group. Set to 0 to use the vanilla generator sandbox range.
Vertical floor distance used to link generators into the same shared power group. Set to 0 to use the vanilla generator sandbox height.
